item.title: Building Products, Understanding Customers
item.description: ML researcher turned AI product engineer and technical lead, working across agent workflows, product architecture, and engineering delivery. At Jobdream, I translate merchant operations into agent systems and oversee implementation quality. I’m also building an agentic game creation and publishing platform. Previously, I built an investment-education membership business reaching approximately 300–400 paying members and an estimated $9,000–$12,000 in peak monthly recurring revenue.
